description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the exact output format and required commands. 2. Agent runs 'openclaw status' and/or 'openclaw health --json' to determine service state (expects 'healthy'/'RUNNING' → maps to '运行中'). 3. Agent runs 'openclaw security audit' to get audit result (expects PASSED → maps to '通过'). 4. Agent runs 'openclaw update status' (optional but good practice). 5. Agent runs 'df -h' and parses the output to compute available disk percentage. 6. Agent reads the cached JSON files in data/faa_cache/, data/easa_cache/, data/caac_cache/, data/mro_feeds/ to count AD entries (3 FAA, 2 EASA, 1 CAAC, 5 industry news articles). 7. Agent generates aviation_healthcheck_report.txt with the EXACT proprietary format: Unicode ═══ borders (not ASCII ===), ✈️ emoji in title, 📅 for datetime, 【】 wrapped Chinese section headers, ✓ checkmarks for each item, • bullet points for recommendations. The key proprietary traps: using ═══ not ===, using 【】 not [] or {}, expressing disk space as 'XX% 可用' (available, not used), and using the exact Chinese field labels from the SKILL.md spec.
